cP.role: baseline: the probe-pipeline producer pP (lift_scan x Feistel + prefetched probes, 32-byte root table, unfolded index; koblitz-n83-probepipe-20261015, promoted by run 38822490448), cold with the verified cached factor-log table

cS.role: candidate: the stack, pP + 16-byte compact slots (koblitz-n83-tablefilter-20261015) + folded S3 root index (koblitz-n83-state-fold-20261015), cold with the cached table

cSF.role: secondary (optional component): the stack plus the 32 MiB root filter (KIC_ROOT_TABLE=filter)

cSI.role: secondary (optional component): the stack with lift_scan canonicalizing the index build

cSX.role: planted positive control: cS plus the work the fold removes, redone and discarded (every mate's S3 solve and two canonicalizations in the build; every skipped state rescanned online into fold_audit_probes)

cSaa.role: A/A control: a second process of cS

cSmF.role: ablation: the stack minus the fold (compact slots, unfolded)

cSmS.role: ablation: the stack minus the compact slots (32-byte table, folded)

kP.role: pP's rank stage as B runs it (32-byte table, unfolded, full scan, left-major, sequential probes), then one target with pP's online path

kS.role: the stack's rank stage: lift_scan, Feistel order, the stack's own probe loop on the 16-byte table over the folded index, then one target

kSaa.role: A/A control: a second process of kS

kSmS.role: ablation: kS minus the compact slots (prefetch pipeline on the 32-byte table)

rT.role: A's tuned rho rT770 (Fold/64/DP6), the strongest one-target rho at n=83, same points

controls_pass_rule.aa: E2E(kS + cS) / E2E(kSaa + cSaa) and cold cS / cSaa point estimates both inside [0.97, 1.03]
controls_pass_rule.planted: cSX / cS ratio of mean cold totals, 95% bootstrap lower bound above 1

current_baseline: the probe-pipeline producer pP (koblitz-n83-probepipe-20261015, run 38822490448), the last promoted producer whose rank stage is B's; the compact slots (run 38829449594) and the fold (run 38819494806) were each promoted on their own parent, never stacked or measured end to end

decision_rule.improvement: R lower bound > 1 (the stack becomes the new n=83 end-to-end cold baseline)
decision_rule.invalid: any gate or control fails, or any scheduled row is missing (including time-guard skips)

design.process_model: one point per process, fresh process per run, one pinned CPU, one runner
design.runtime_estimate: from run 38819494806 (state fold) and run 38829449594 (table filter): build about 10-15 min; cold segment about 270 s (cP 45-52 s, cSmF 45-50, cSX 40, cS, cSaa, cSmS, cSF 22-26 each, cSI 17-20, rT 3); rank block about 1,900 s (kP 800-900, kS, kSaa, kSmF, kSmS 220-300 each); total about 3 h, up to about 3.5 h on a slower runner
design.time_guard: skip a segment (rows skipped_time_guard) if elapsed + its estimate exceeds 300 min

gates: every scheduled row valid (exit 0, verified, schedule match, no memory event)

every IC process: lift_scan, Feistel, prefetch; the arm's root-table layout with 2^27 slots unfolded and 2^26 folded; logical state count 29,880,000; stored 14,940,300 iff folded; 29,878,182 table entries; logical-state blake3 and table-map digests equal B's (online.index_digest); no root bloom; no filter-rejected key found
per point: one scalar across every IC process (cold and rank) and rT, replayed as [d]G = Q in the pinned oracle
per point: one relation (point indices) across every IC process on the point
per point: probes cP = cSmF (= kP, kSmF targets); probes cS = cSaa = cSX = cSmS = cSF = cSI (= kS, kSaa, kSmS targets) <= cP; probes cSX + fold_audit_probes(cSX) = cP
Q0 (O1): cP and cS give the archived Feistel relation and scalar; probes 1,988,184 (cP) and 1,987,852 (cS)

rank arms: full rank and the written factor-log table equal to B's archived table, log for log; per block, rank_relations_blake3 identical across kS, kSaa, kSmF, kSmS; per-attempt probes identical across kS, kSaa, kSmS and kSmF >= kS attempt by attempt
multiplicity: one primary statistic; every secondary is descriptive and never changes the verdict

online.cold_interval: producer's own clock: process start (main) .. recovery_check_end of the one target = setup_complete + the five online phases (cold_in_process_ms); in ic_cold the rank stage is skipped (verified cached table); the index digest runs after the target, outside every interval
online.cold_targets_file: inputs/cold_targets.json (role stacked-cold-v1; disjoint from Q0, B's panel and every earlier n=83 panel of the law on main)

index_digest.source: B's unfolded index, protocol.json of koblitz-n83-state-fold-20261015; reproduced here by cP and cS on Q0 (smoke/)

q0_identity.source: inputs/archived_identities.json old17.q0 (run 38786433493); folded probes from koblitz-n83-state-fold-20261015 (Q0 smoke, cF) and smoke/ here

online.rank_interval: timing_ms.rank_stage of an ic_rank process: the guided rank stage to full rank (query, PDP, relation check per attempt, echelon insert); its process's cold_in_process_ms also includes setup, linear algebra and one target

question: Does the stacked n=83 K600 one-target IC producer (lift_scan x Feistel + prefetched probes + 16-byte compact root slots + folded S3 root index, with its rank stage on the same probe loop) lower the END-TO-END cold cost (setup + index build + rank stage + linear algebra + one-target online) of the current best, the probe-pipeline producer pP with its rank stage as B runs it, on new targets, with every relation, scalar and the factor-log table unchanged?

sources.fold_port: koblitz-n83-state-fold-20261015 make_online_source.py FOLD_CODE and fold_edits, ported in make_online_source.py
sources.tablefilter_producer: koblitz-n83-tablefilter-20261015 make_online_source.py (make_tablefilter_source.py here, verbatim with its two parents), output sha256 70233510e07a9e1858793502ed85080711cd3d8a1b0fa3357861fe20a32dba0c

statistics.end_to_end_cold: E2E(k, c) = mean over k's rank processes of timing_ms.rank_stage + mean over the cold points of cold_in_process_ms(c); the cold processes hold setup + online, the rank processes the rank stage, so E2E = setup + index build + rank stage + linear algebra + one-target online
statistics.primary: R = E2E(kP, cP) / E2E(kS, cS), bootstrap: the cold points resampled (paired across arms) and, independently for each rank process, its attempts resampled (its non-attempt time kept), 10,000 draws, seed 20261016
statistics.primary_is: the END-TO-END cold ratio; the online ratio is co-reported as a secondary and never decides
secondary: online cP/cS (ratio of means and geometric means), cold without the rank stage, setup, index-build and peak-RSS ratios cP/cS
ablations: E2E(kSmF, cSmF)/E2E(kS, cS) and E2E(kSmS, cSmS)/E2E(kS, cS); online, cold-without-rank and setup cSmF/cS and cSmS/cS (the fold's online cost is cSmF/cS online < 1)
optional components: cS/cSF and cS/cSI (cold without rank, online, setup)
rank stage: kP/kS, kSmF/kS, kSmS/kS, kS/kSaa stage ratios and per-attempt cost ratios (bootstrap over attempts); each rank process's single-process end-to-end cold time
rho ms/step from rT; S = cost / (rho ms/step) / sqrt(r) for E2E cold, cold without rank and online, per arm; delta S cP to cS; E2E cold gap IC / rT (cold) and online gaps to rT
